$description: VLC Redesign design tokens (design-1.0): the values the desktop app draws with at 100 % (1 px = 1 Figma px). Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group ($value, $type, $description). $extensions.org.vlc-redesign gives the Figma node (file fQSxoEi1zmnD5fQacw0qGs, "VLC Redesign (Community)" by Juxtopposed, CC BY 4.0) and the code that uses the value; design/tools/check_qml.py fails when the code and this file differ.

org.vlc-redesign.license: CC BY 4.0, Juxtopposed (design values); the code references are GPL-2.0-or-later

dark.$description: The dark theme: the design's own values.

b1.$description: Dark/BG/B1: window background; Settings, dialogs and the compact library at 95 %.

b1Canvas.$description: Dark/BG/B1 at 95 % as Figma shows it over its canvas (Add Subtitles card).

b2.$description: Dark/BG/B2: seek bar background, wells, text inputs, dialog title bars, Settings header.

a2.$description: Dark/BG/A2: the hovered row of the widget (right-click) menus.

a3.$description: Dark/BG/A3: control bar, player top bar, buttons.

a4.$description: Dark/BG/A4 (and A3 Transparent): library sidebar, controls; menus, dialogs and the seek preview at 95 %.

folderCard.$description: Home: the folder cards (not a Figma style).

2.$description: Dark/FG/2: Settings section titles, text typed in the dialogs.

a1.$description: Dark/FG/A1: secondary text (textSecondary), the Settings title.

a2.$description: Dark/FG/A2: muted text (textMuted): menu labels, icons, the outline of the two-tone icons.

a3.$description: Dark/FG/A3: menu shortcuts, dimmed items, notes. The same in the light theme.

b1.$description: Dark/FG/B1: text on the accent (onboarding primary button), New playlist icon wrapper.

warning.$description: Settings warnings and errors (not a Figma style).

widgetHandle.$description: Scroll bar handle of the classic (widget) dialogs. The QML Settings scroll bar keeps the Basic style's own colours in the dark theme.

widgetHandleHover.$description: Hovered scroll bar handle of the classic dialogs (both themes).

light.$description: The light theme: what VLCStyle.redesign.color() returns for the dark value (measured from Figma "Player - Light", 2425:13624).

b1Canvas.$description: Light of the 95 % B1 over the canvas.

b2.$description: Light of Dark/BG/B2 (also the QML dialog title bars: the colour map wins over the fallback the dialog passes).

a2.$description: Light of Dark/BG/A2: the hovered row of the widget menus (RedesignMenuStyle; not in the QML colour map).

a4.$description: Light of Dark/BG/A4; menus and the seek preview at 95 %.

folderCard.$description: Light of the Home folder cards.

a2.$description: Light of Dark/FG/A2 (the muted texts and icons read dark grey).

b1.$description: Light of Dark/FG/B1 where the code gives one (New playlist icon wrapper); elsewhere FG/B1 stays as it is.

warning.$description: Settings warnings and errors in the light theme.

classic.$description: Title bar of the classic (widget) dialogs in the light theme. The QML dialogs draw theirs in color.light.bg.b2 (#DEDEDE).

handle.$description: Settings scroll bar handle in the light theme (palette.mid of the Basic ScrollBar).

handlePressed.$description: Settings scroll bar handle, pressed, in the light theme (palette.dark).

widgetHandle.$description: Scroll bar handle of the classic dialogs in the light theme.

accent.$description: The accent: one of the 9 choices of the onboarding and Settings (redesign/accent), or the system's ("system"). Dim = 0.81 x the accent, Bright = 0.26 x the accent (dark theme), Bright (light) = #DEDEDE tinted with 35 % of the accent; the default's Dim and Bright are the design's values. Computed values may differ by 1 in a channel from what Qt's float rounding gives.

defaultDim.$description: Dark/Accent/DIm of the default accent (the design's value, not 0.81 x).

defaultBright.$description: Dark/BG/Accent Bright of the default accent: selection and seek fill, ON toggle label.

logo.$description: Dark/Accent/Logo: the cone, whatever the accent.

choice.$description: VLCStyle.redesign.accentChoices, in the onboarding's order (check_qml.py compares the list and recomputes dim, bright and brightLight).

brightLight.$description: Orange, Bright in the light theme.

bright.$description: Red, Bright (Qt's float rounding may give #3A150D).

brightLight.$description: Red, Bright in the light theme.
Yellow, Bright in the light theme.
Green, Bright in the light theme.
Cyan, Bright in the light theme.
Blue, Bright in the light theme.
Purple, Bright in the light theme.
Pink, Bright in the light theme.
Grey, Bright in the light theme.

dimFactor.$description: Accent Dim = this x each channel of the accent.

brightFactor.$description: Accent Bright (dark theme) = this x each channel of the accent.

lightTintBase.$description: Accent Bright (light theme) = this colour tinted with the accent.

lightTintAmount.$description: How much of the accent the light Accent Bright takes.

minLuminance.$description: A system accent darker than this (WCAG relative luminance, the blue) is lightened to it (HSL lightness, hue and saturation kept).

maxLuminance.$description: A system accent lighter than this (the grey) is darkened to it.

interface.$description: Inter 3.19 (variable), modified: every advance one font unit wider (design/fonts/InterVariable.ttf). Distance-field rendering, no hinting, greyscale antialiasing.

mono.$description: DM Mono Regular: the keycaps of Keyboard Shortcuts (design/fonts/DMMono-Regular.ttf).
